descriere_scurta: Field-generating current setpoint smoothing time constant
descriere: Sets the smoothing time constant for the setpoint of the field-generating current components. The current filtered in this way is included in the calculation of the cos phi.
Sets the gain factor to weight the excitation current setpoint.
Sets the dynamic response factor for the current model controller.
Sets the integral time for the current model controller. This value is automatically pre-set using p3900 or p0340 when commissioning has been completed.

descriere_scurta: Excitation current actual value signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the excitation current actual value

descriere_scurta: Minimum excitation current closed-loop control gain factor
descriere: Sets the gain factor for the minimum excitation current, closed-loop control. This is active if the excitation current is below 75 % of p1642.

descriere_scurta: Current setpoint torque-generating smoothing time minimum
descriere: Sets the minimum smoothing time constant for the setpoint of the torque-generating current components.

descriere_scurta: Curr. setpoint torque-gen. smoothing time field weakening range
descriere: Sets the smoothing time constant for the setpoint of the torque-generating current components.

descriere_scurta: Manipulated variable filter 1 velocity controller type
descriere: Sets the type for manipulated variable filter 1 of the velocity controller

descriere_scurta: Manip. var. filter 1 velocity controller denom. natural freq.
descriere: Sets the denominator natural frequency for manipulated variable filter 1 of the velocity controller.

descriere_scurta: Manip. var. filter 1 velocity controller numerator natural freq.
descriere: Sets the numerator natural frequency for manipulated variable filter 1 of the velocity controller.

descriere_scurta: Manip. variable filter 1 velocity controller numerator damping
descriere: Sets the numerator damping for manipulated variable filter 1 of the velocity controller.

descriere_scurta: Manipulated variable filter 2 velocity controller type
descriere: Sets the type for manipulated variable filter 2 of the velocity controller

descriere_scurta: Manip. var. filter 2 velocity controller denom. natural freq.
descriere: Sets the denominator natural frequency for manipulated variable filter 2 of the velocity controller.
Sets the current setpoint filter 3 as low pass (PT2) or general 2nd-order filter.

descriere_scurta: Current setpoint filter 3 denominator natural frequency
descriere: Sets the denominator natural frequency for current setpoint filter 3 (PT2, general filter).
Sets the denominator damping for current setpoint filter 3.

descriere_scurta: Current setpoint filter 3 numerator natural frequency
descriere: Sets the numerator natural frequency for current setpoint filter 3 (general filter).
Sets the numerator damping for current setpoint filter 3.
Sets the current setpoint filter 4 as low pass (PT2) or general 2nd-order filter.

descriere_scurta: Current setpoint filter 4 denominator natural frequency
descriere: Sets the denominator natural frequency for current setpoint filter 4 (PT2, general filter).
Sets the denominator damping for current setpoint filter 4.

descriere_scurta: Current setpoint filter 4 numerator natural frequency
descriere: Sets the numerator natural frequency for current setpoint filter 4 (general filter).
Sets the numerator damping for current setpoint filter 4.

descriere_scurta: Current controller reference model dead time
descriere: Sets the fractional dead time for the current controller reference model. This parameter emulates the computing dead time of the proportionally controlled current control loop.
Sets the scaling of the dynamic current controller pre-control for the torque/force-generating current component Isq.
Threshold for the setpoint - actual value tracking of the EMF pre-control of the Isq current controller.
Sets the weakening of the proportional gain for large actuating signals for the force controller. The setting value specifies what percentage of a P component of 10 V is weakened.
Sets the integral time of the force controller.

descriere_scurta: Force controller D component smoothing time constant
descriere: Sets the smoothing time constant of the D component for the force controller.
Sets the derivative-action time for the force controller.
Sets the precontrol filter as low pass (PT2) or as general 2nd-order filter.
Sets the denominator natural frequency for the precontrol filter (PT2, general filter).
Sets the denominator damping for the precontrol filter (PT2, general filter).
Sets the numerator natural frequency for the precontrol filter (general filter).

descriere_scurta: Isd controller integral component shutdown threshold
descriere: Sets the speed threshold for deactivating the integral component of the Isd controller. The d current controller is only effective as P controller for speeds greater than the threshold value. Instead of the integral component, the quadrature arm decoupling is effective.

descriere_scurta: Isd controller combination current time component
descriere: Sets the time constant to calculate the d current DC component difference (combination current) to add to the d current controller actual value.

descriere_scurta: Gain resonance damping for encoderless closed-loop control
descriere: Defines the gain of the controller for resonance damping for operation with sensorless vector control in the range that current is injected.

descriere_scurta: Motor model speed threshold stall detection
descriere: Sets the speed threshold value to detect a stalled motor. If the adaptation controller output exceeds the parameterized speed difference, then in status word r1408.11 is set = 1.

descriere_scurta: Motor model error threshold stall detection
descriere: Sets the fault threshold in order to detect a motor that has stalled. If the error signal (r1746) exceeds the parameterized error threshold, then status signal r1408.12 is set to 1.

descriere_scurta: Motor model lower changeover speed n_set -> n_act
descriere: Sets the lower speed for the transition "n_set -> n_act" in encoderless operation. This value is entered as a percentage referred to p1749.

descriere_scurta: Motor model upper changeover speed / increase changeover speed /
descriere: Separately-excited synchronous motor: Sets the upper speed for the transition "n_set -> n_act" in sensorless operation. This value is entered as a percentage of p1755. Induction motor without speed encoder: Depending on the machine data, the drive has calculated a minimum value of the operating frequency for rugged operation. If the minimum value is greater than the lower changeover limit parameterized with p1755 * (1 - 2 * p1756), then the difference is displayed using p1749 * p1755. The parameter value cannot be changed.
Sets the velocity threshold for the message "Motor locked".

descriere_scurta: Motor model changeover speed hysteresis operation with encoder /
descriere: Sets the hysteresis for the changeover speed of the motor model for operation with speed encoder.

Sets the smoothing time constant to filter the main flux angle difference from the voltage and current models. The filtered value is included in the calculation of the total flux angle. PESM: Sets the smoothing time constant for the angular difference display between motor model and encoder.

descriere_scurta: Motor model w/o enc. op./cl.-loop controlled stab. controller Kp
descriere: Sets the gain of the transient response controller when the motor model changes over from open-loop controlled operation to closed-loop controlled operation.

descriere_scurta: Motor model changeover delay time open/closed-loop control
descriere: Sets the minimum time for a transition from open-loop controlled to closed-loop controlled operation after the lower changeover speed p1755 * (1 - p1756 / 100 %) has been exceeded.

descriere_scurta: Motor model with encoder speed adaptation Kp
descriere: Sets the proportional gain of the controller for speed adaptation with encoder

descriere_scurta: Motor model without encoder speed adaptation Kp
descriere: Sets the proportional gain of the controller for speed adaptation without encoder.

descriere_scurta: Motor model voltage model calculation enable
descriere: Sets the speed to enable the voltage model to calculate the speed actual value. This value is entered as a percentage referred to p1752. For separately-excited synchronous motors without encoder, the parameter is referred to p1748.

descriere_scurta: Motor model without encoder speed adaptation Tn
descriere: Sets the integral time of the controller for speed adaptation without encoder

descriere_scurta: Motor model offset voltage compensation alpha
descriere: Sets the offset voltage in the alpha direction; this compensates the offset voltages of the drive converter/inverter at low speeds. The value is valid for the rated (nominal) pulse frequency of the power unit.

descriere_scurta: Motor model offset voltage compensation beta
descriere: Sets the offset voltage in the beta direction; this compensates the offset voltages of the drive converter/inverter at low speeds. The value is valid for the rated (nominal) pulse frequency of the power unit.
Sets the scaling for model fault feedback.
Sets the proportional gain for the Lh adaptation of the motor model for an induction motor (ASM).

descriere_scurta: Motor model kT adaptation smoothing time
descriere: Sets the smoothing time of the kT adaptation of the motor model for a permanent-magnet synchronous motor (PEM).

descriere_scurta: Motor model pulse technique speed adaptation Kp
descriere: Sets the proportional gain Kp for speed adaptation with active pulse technique for the estimation of the continuous rotor position.
Sets the manipulated variable filter as low pass (PT2) or as extended general 2nd order filter.

descriere_scurta: Manipulated variable filter numerator natural freq.
descriere: Sets the numerator natural frequency for the manipulated variable filter (general filter).
Sets the numerator damping for the manipulated variable filter (general filter).
Sets the filter time constant of the DC link voltage used to calculate the modulation depth.

descriere_scurta: can be used to reverse the phase sequence and encoder actual value.
descriere: Setting to change the direction. If the parameter is changed, it reverses the direction of rotation of the cylinder and the encoder actual value without changing the setpoint.

descriere_scurta: Transition point compensation Q1 positive zero range
descriere: Sets the flow rate Q for point 1 positive (zero range) of the transition point compensation. The characteristic for the transition point compensation comprises the following value pairs: Flow rate (Q) / voltage (U) Positive range: - p1833 / p1834 --> Point 1 pos (zero range), rounding p1835 - p1839 / p1840 --> Point 2 pos, rounding p1841 - p1845 / p1846 --> Point 3 pos (saturation) Negative range: - p1836 / p1837 --> Point 1 neg (zero range), rounding p1838 - p1842 / p1843 --> Point 2 neg, rounding p1844 - p1847 / p1848 --> Point 3 neg (saturation)

descriere_scurta: Transition point compensation Q1 negative zero range
descriere: Sets the flow rate Q for point 1 negative (zero range) of the transition point compensation.
Sets the rounding for point 2 positive of the transition point compensation.
Sets the flow rate Q for point 2 negative of the transition point compensation.
Sets the rounding for point 2 negative of the transition point compensation.

descriere_scurta: Transition point compensation Q3 positive saturation
descriere: Sets the flow rate Q for point 3 positive (saturation) of the transition point compensation.
Sets the damping factor for the actual value correction. The factor multiplies the T0/Tsig ratio in the feedback branch of the LR element.

descriere_scurta: Transition point compensation Q3 negative saturation
descriere: Sets the flow rate Q for point 3 negative (saturation) of the transition point compensation.
Sets the limit for the positive control voltage.
Sets the pole position identification technique.
Sets the integral time when executing the motion-based pole position identification.
Sets the maximum distance (electrical angle) when carrying out the pole position identification routine. If this distance (travel) is exceeded, an appropriate fault is output.
Sets the angle that is added to the commutating angle.
Sets the current when executing the motion-based pole position identification.
Sets the rise time of the current when executing the motion-based pole position identification.
Sets the gain when executing the motion-based pole position identification.

descriere_scurta: Ang. commutation offset calibr. and PollD scaling
descriere: Sets the scaling for the runtime of the automatic encoder calibration and of the pole position identification technique in which the current is injected.

Sets the torque threshold value for the signal "Torque setpoint < torque threshold value 1" (BO: r2198.10).
Sets the delay time for the message "Motor blocked" (BO: r2198.6).
